All three files are in place and passing accessibility checks. Here's what was built:

---

**`index.html`** — shell document  
**`styles.css`** — full dark design system (~32 KB)  
**`app.js`** — React-style component architecture in vanilla JS (~36 KB)

### Sections
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| **Sticky Nav** | Logo, category links, search/cart icons, mobile hamburger drawer |
| **Hero** | Full-bleed dark layout with copy, stats, image collage, live shopper pill |
| **Marquee Strip** | Animated promo ticker (respects `prefers-reduced-motion`) |
| **Category Rail** | Horizontally scrollable icon + label category nav |
| **Featured Products** | 8-product responsive grid with badges, ratings, wishlist, add-to-cart |
| **Deals & Promotions** | Featured sale card with live countdown timer + two promo cards |
| **Editorial / Journal** | Asymmetric lookbook grid with hover reveal |
| **Testimonials** | 3-column review cards |
| **Newsletter** | Two-column sign-up with email validation |
| **Brands Bar** | "As featured in" logos strip |
| **Footer** | 4-column links + social icons + legal |
| **Cart Drawer** | Slide-in sidebar with live item list, remove, subtotal |
| **Toast Notifications** | Add-to-cart, wishlist, newsletter confirmations |

### Accessibility
- Skip-to-content link, semantic landmarks, `aria-label`/`aria-pressed`/`aria-expanded` throughout, focus trap on cart drawer, `role="dialog"`, `aria-live` regions for toasts.
